draft_email.subject: Eastvale Power: urgent account health check
draft_email.body:
Hi,

We're seeing a significant drop in product usage at Eastvale Power—active weekly users fell 48.9% from 111.5 to 57.0 over the last 16 weeks, and the named champion Nadia Sandoval departed 36 days ago with no replacement assigned. Latest invoice INV-90204 for $14,825 is 47 days overdue. Given the high-risk status and the existing exec sponsor engagement (41 days), I'd like to schedule a quick sync to understand what's driving the decline, address the billing issue, and discuss champion onboarding to protect the renewal on 2026-12-02.

Best,
[Your Name]

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Chooses which accounts to investigate and the hypotheses to test

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Writes churn-risk claims, each citing a Zetaris fact

agents.name: Verifier
agents.role: Rejects claims the data does not support, sends drafts back when a signal is missed, checks the Skeptic's rulings

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.role: Argues against every claim and looks for innocent explanations

agents.name: Escalation
agents.role: Escalates high-risk, high-revenue or near-renewal accounts

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Writes the brief, the recommended play and a draft email

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Recalls earlier weeks per account, stores this week's verdict, rewards helpful memories
